name: w4b_tools_during_decode
description: Foreground agent decoding 256-token replies while a background agent runs real tool steps that compete for CPU and disk (findstr across a source tree, a Python disk+CPU hog). The server processes keep the GPU, but their token loop is scheduled on the CPU, so a saturated CPU shows up as a drop in decode tok/s and a rise in ITL p99. On an elevated trace the collector's prefill_runq_ms / decode_runq_ms (runnable-but-waiting) in each request window attributes the slowdown to CPU starvation. Note: tool steps use the CMD shell; keep commands read-only and short. The hog script lives in workloads\hogs\ and only writes to the system temp dir.
